lastCompletedStory.title: Wire fail-closed preflight at the 3 supervisor worker-dispatch sites

nextStoryContext: codexAuthPreflight (US-001, src/supervisor/codex-auth.ts) is now wired into all 3 supervisor worker-dispatch sites: loop.ts (implementer, immediately before its respawn-pane call, ~line 1180), review.ts (reviewer, immediately before its respawn-pane call, ~line 402), and plan-runner.ts (planner + auditor, inside the new resolveAndSpawnPlanner/resolveAndSpawnAuditor helpers, immediately before their respawn-pane calls). Each site got an optional codexAuthCheckFn?: CodexAuthCheck DI seam on its options interface (RunSupervisorOptions, MakeReviewDispatchOptions, RunPlanPhaseOptions), destructured once and passed as authCheck into codexAuthPreflight({backend, model, authCheck: codexAuthCheckFn}) using the SAME already-resolved backend/model locals the argv builder and emitSpawnResolution use (never re-read). When absent (the default in every production wiring -- host.ts/sidecar.ts do NOT explicitly wire it), codexAuthPreflight falls back to its own default (real codexAuthCheck, ~/.codex/auth.json presence). On abort: loop.ts returns {status:'blocked', lastOutcome:{kind:'blocked', detail: 'codex-auth-failed: ...'}} (mirrors the B-2 container-not-ready block, fires escalateFn fire-and-forget with try/catch, calls finishTerminal('blocked')); review.ts returns {status:'error', detail: 'codex-auth-failed: ...'} (mirrors its own container-not-ready block); plan-runner.ts adds a new PlanPhaseResult union member {kind:'codex-auth-failed', phase:'planner'|'auditor', reason} (mirrors container-preflight-failed one-for-one, falls through runPostAuditAction's if-chain to the generic no-action bucket with zero special-casing, exactly like container-preflight-failed already does) and fires escalateFn fire-and-forget from inside resolveAndSpawnPlanner/Auditor. plan-runner.ts's runPlanWorkerSequence was refactored to extract two new helpers, runPlannerSpawnStep/runAuditorSpawnStep (each returning PlanPhaseResult | string, a block result or the live pane id), to keep it under biome's noExcessiveCognitiveComplexity(max=15) after adding the 2 new abort branches (pattern documented in patterns.md). US-003 (the 4th and final dispatch site, run.ts orchestrator) should mirror this exact shape -- see the new patterns.md bullet 'Wiring codexAuthPreflight into a worker-dispatch site' for the full recipe, including the test-authoring gotcha (a codex-backend test needs BOTH [backend] and a non-claude-alias [models] entry in its scratch project.toml, or codexAuthPreflight's claude-alias-model check aborts before authCheck is ever invoked) and the async-helper footgun (withCodexBackendCwd must be `async` and `return await fn()` inside try, never a bare `return fn()`, or the finally's cwd-restore/rmSync races the awaited test body). File-size ceilings were raised for loop.ts/plan-runner.ts/review.ts/loop.test.ts/review.test.ts (all at or near their prior ceilings already) -- see scripts/file-size-budget.json's _ref for the exact before/after line counts.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure internal wiring of the already-built (US-001) codexAuthPreflight decision fn into 3 existing dispatch call sites; no new external API surface touched.
